rows.label: Formula
rows.text:
Scalar triple product $[\vec{a}\ \vec{b}\ \vec{c}] = \vec{a}\cdot(\vec{b}\times\vec{c})$ is the volume of the parallelepiped; it is zero for coplanar vectors.
Vector triple product: $\vec{a}\times(\vec{b}\times\vec{c}) = (\vec{a}\cdot\vec{c})\vec{b} - (\vec{a}\cdot\vec{b})\vec{c}$.
